QR encoder vendored unchanged from `qrcode-generator` 1.4.4 (`qrcode.js`).
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/1.4.4
License: MIT, copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase; upstream notice retained in source.

Only ASCII order IDs and six-digit pickup codes are encoded. Rendering uses native
mini-program views with a four-module quiet zone. No browser, canvas, remote image
service or extra asset is needed. Independent decoding is tested with jsQR.
